specific_testable_hypothesis.statement: An in-process call-binding or namespace/reference integrity change after training history may be responsible for at least one failure. NSD message is compatible with an unexpected object being resolved where torch.Tensor is accessed; HVD is compatible with a wrong runtime memo argument/binding; PSC is compatible with a wrong callable reference in the worker. A common cause across all three remains unproved.
specific_testable_hypothesis.what_would_distinguish_it: Capture actual failing frame locals/globals and bound-method identity in the original failure, rather than checking a fresh object after the process has exited.
alternatives_not_excluded: Distinct independent implementation/library defects at the three sites.
Training-history-specific Python object mutation, extension interaction or process-specific state not present in fresh imports.
Runtime binary/ABI or hardware faults; file hashes alone cannot adjudicate these.
